# Djondzo Escolar
Official website: https://djondzo.co.mz/
Djondzo Escolar is a school management system focused on academic, administrative and financial workflows for schools.

- https://djondzo.co.mz/gestao-academica

- https://djondzo.co.mz/app-mobile
- https://djondzo.co.mz/whatsapp
- https://djondzo.co.mz/precos
- https://djondzo.co.mz/blog
Primary language: Portuguese (Mozambique).
Market: Mozambique.
